critic_note: Reads as a teapot with broken lid and stray handle line. Draw a round brass pot (handi) with two small side handles, wide neck, golden-yellow with a gleam.
Identical to 254; plural lost. Draw two small rooms/doors side by side, each with a bed or window.
Trapezoid with banks looks like a tent/roof; sun is off in a corner. Draw a straight blue canal from top view of a gentle perspective with grass banks, ripples, one small tree.
Outline only, unfilled and white, off-style (others have fills). Fill with cream/blue, add one soft fold crease and corner tassels, keep heavy navy outline.
Cow, goat, hen crowded; cow body not connected to head and legs look broken. Draw one cute animal (cow) in the mascot style with full body.

Reads as a flower/cloud: boll circles overlap with outline clutter at top and leaves look like a sprig. Draw 3 open green bolls (brown star-shaped husk) each bursting a fluffy white puff, on a branch.
Banana is a detached orange crescent that reads as peel. Make it yellow, curved, with a brown tip and stem; fix apple/orange overlap and add a third fruit so 'fruit' (plural idea) is clear.
